data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Raphael means 'God heals'. This name was popular among the ancient Israelites and was also borne by the archangel Raphael, who healed the Israelites during their journey in the desert. In Christianity, Raffaello is a variant of Raphael, and it carries the same spiritual significance. The name Raffaello carries the meaning “God heals” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Raffaello usually hope their child will grow to embody god heals and live with faith, good character and purpose.
